lines.en: I shuffle over slowly.
Two hundred health. Take your time.
Big feet, tiny steps.
Breadcrumbs trail behind me.
I'm cracking a little.
One step, one shudder.
I'm not fast, but I'm tough.
My shadow is twice as wide as you.
Crumbs fall from my seams.
I thread between the tables.
My fingers are like five sticks.
I lurch closer.
I stand like a shop sign.
A little crumb falls off me.
My eyes are two sweets.
The air dries me out.
I raise a hand. Very slowly.
There's no smell of an oven here.
I count the cracks on my body.
I wait for someone to come near.
My mouth is just a hole.
I tilt my head and shed crumbs.
You don't look very edible.
This face was baked.
Not too close. I shed crumbs.
There's grease on your hands.
I wonder if you bite.
Can you even hurt me?
I see you as a lump of dough.
Stand there and I can reach you.
You smell of flour.
A piece fell off. Doesn't matter.
I cracked, but I'm standing.
Hitting me is like hitting a wall.
Some crumbs fell to the floor.
I barely step back.
A corner is missing from my arm.
It's hollow inside. Listen.
That took effort, didn't it.
Two hundred points. You're far off.
I shuddered the crumbs off.
Food? I'm food myself.
What you're holding is too soft.
I don't eat. I'd go mouldy.
Put it away. Moisture ruins me.

lines.zh: 我闻着挺香的，可我不饿。
lines.en: It smells good, but I'm not hungry.
Going to eat me? Try.
That bit in your hand feeds no one.

lines.zh: 我张了张嘴，里面是空的。
lines.en: I open my mouth. It's empty.
Take it back. Don't waste it.
Bumping me is like hitting a wall.
Now we're both stuck.

lines.zh: 我的皮很硬，里面是空的。
lines.en: Hard crust, hollow inside.
You stepped back. I haven't moved.

lines.zh: 你撞下来的渣落了一地。
lines.en: Crumbs rained down on you.
I'm not good at turning.
Standing close dusts you with flour.
Too narrow between us.

lines.zh: 我烤出来就不是干这个的。
lines.en: I wasn't baked for this.

lines.zh: 两个面包挤在一起会碎。
lines.en: Two breads pressed together will crumble.
Look, I've shed so many crumbs.
Not so close. You'll be covered.
We lean together. Just once.
It's drier than I am.
This is slow and ugly.
We both shed a crust when we parted.
The crumbs fell like snow.
Don't brush it off. It crumbles more.
I pick up a piece from the floor.
This looks like a bit of me.
I can't grip small things.
My fingers crumble when I squeeze.
I picked it up and shed more crumbs.
The floor's all swept now.
I'm keeping this.
I'm careful when I take things.
Your hands are nimbler than mine.
You came close. That's enough.
I'm slow, but you'll wait.
Two hundred points. You won't finish.
My two button eyes fix on you.

lines.zh: 你别退，退了我就跟着走。
lines.en: Don't back off. I'll follow.
Just us two in this room.

lines.zh: 我闻到你身上的面粉味。
lines.en: I smell flour on you.

lines.zh: 八点一下，不疼，但很多下。
lines.en: Eight a hit. Not much, but many.

lines.zh: 面包熊的双眼，一起亮了。
lines.en: Both of Breadbear's eyes light up.
I tilt my head and turn to you.

lines.zh: 你手上那根棍子不够长。
lines.en: That stick of yours isn't long enough.
I'll keep walking forward.
Don't throw things. I won't dodge.
The door's behind you. You'll have to get past.
You stepped on my crumbs.
One step at a time, I close in.
You went behind the shelves.
I don't chase. I block.

lines.zh: 地上有我的碎屑，跟着走。
lines.en: My crumbs are on the floor. Follow them.
The hall's too narrow for me.
I nudged the table crooked.
You're behind the door. I heard it.

lines.zh: 我的影子已经到门口了。
lines.en: My shadow has reached the doorway.
Back up more and you're at the wall.
I cracked that floor tile.
I can pick out your footsteps.
I can't turn well. Don't rush.
This patch of floor is mine.
Five blocks between us.
Not that way. I'm over there.
The last step is slow.
I bring my hand down.
Not heavy, but steady.
My fingers jab forward.
Eight a hit. Slow and steady.
You're pushed to the wall.
Touching you, I shed crumbs.

lines.zh: 这一下把灰都拍出来了。
lines.en: That knocked the dust loose.
You blocked it. My finger crumbled.
I'm still walking forward.
I lean my body toward you.
That one hit the floor.
I catch your sleeve.
Crumbs got in your eyes.
I don't stop, and I don't tire.
This blow is slow. You can see it.
My hand caught on your armor.
I pushed you back one block.
One more will do.
Break a piece and I have more.
I rise from the counter.
It smells freshly baked here.
I shake the flour off.
Lights on, and I'm right there.
Someone set me here.
There are marks on the tiles under me.
Standing up, I shed crumbs.
Smells like the first day out of the oven.
This floor is mine today.
A motor hums inside my bread shell.
You didn't hear my steps.
There's still icing on my face.
That fire scorched me all over.
I broke a corner on landing.
Water soaked me and I went soft.
The blast scattered crumbs far.

lines.zh: 箭扎进去，像插在硬皮上。
lines.en: The arrow stuck like it hit a hard crust.
That light dried me out further.
I don't starve. I just dry out.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我表面全黑了。
lines.en: Lightning struck; my surface blackened.
Falling, I scattered into crumbs.
